column1: # Respawning creatures: what comes back, how long it takes, and where. The owner edits this file; the game reads it when it is built.
# Columns are separated by tabs. Lines starting with # are notes.
#   range_metres               the player must be farther than this from the spawn point
#   timer_seconds              how long after the death before it may come back
#   require_no_line_of_sight   1: and the player must not see the spawn point; 0: distance alone
#   per_minute                 at most this many come back in any minute
#   per_module                 at most this many come back in one visit to an area
#   xp_share                   the share of a kill's experience a creature that came back pays: 0.5 is half
# By default only an enemy killed in a fight comes back: one with no conversation of its own, no plot flag, not a party member, no
# script of its own for its death, and not one a script or a cutscene killed. The rows below change that, by module prefix and tag
# prefix (a * is any module; an empty tag prefix is every creature there). `exclude` wins over `include`.
# include <module prefix> <tag prefix>     also a creature that is not an enemy (a bystander, a guard), by tag
# The scripted openings: the Endar Spire and the Leviathan.
